camel_example: aliyun iot UpdateProductTags --region cn-hangzhou --ProductTag.1.TagValue 202 --ProductTag.1.TagKey room --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000
description_zh: 调用该接口更新产品标签
kebab_example: aliyun iot update-product-tags --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --product-tag TagKey=room TagValue=202 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateProductTags

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or </ph></props>instance ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product. The ProductKey is a globally unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for a new product. You can view the information about all products under the current account in the IoT Platform console or by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html
parameters.help_zh: 产品的ProductKey。ProductKey是物联网平台为新建产品颁发的产品Key，作为其全局唯一标识符。您可以在物联网平台控制台查看或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看当前账号下所有产品的信息
parameters.name: product_key

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the product tag. The key can be up to 30 characters in length and can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, and periods (.).

The TagKey that you specify must be an existing tag key. The TagKey values cannot be duplicate
fields.help_zh:
产品标签键（key）。长度不可超过30个字符，可包含英文大小写字母，数字和英文句号（.）。

传入标签的TagKey必须是已存在的标签key。传入标签的TagKey不能重复
fields.name: tag_key

fields.help_en: The updated tag value. The value can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). A Chinese character counts as two characters
fields.help_zh: 更新后的标签值（value）。长度不可超过128字符，可包含中文、英文字母、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。一个中文汉字算2个字符
fields.name: tag_value
